name: NWA World Championship Wrestling
description: Showcasing incredible in-ring action and unforgettable interviews, this weekly television series features a who's who of WWE Hall of Famers.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 02, 1985
videos.overview: While speculation over whether Dusty Rhodes will be physically able to challenge Ric Flair for the NWA World Heavyweight Championship runs rampant, the rivalry between Magnum T.A. and United States Champion Tully Blanchard takes an unexpected turn. Plus, "Superstar" Billy Graham, The Rock 'n' Roll Express, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 09, 1985
videos.overview: As the road to Starrcade continues, the Four Horsemen await the challenges of their rivals and let everyone know exactly where they stand. Plus, United States Champion Tully Blanchard, National Heavyweight Champion Terry Taylor, The Barbarian, 'Nature Boy' Buddy Landel, and many more in action of this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 16, 1985
videos.overview: On a night where NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair and National Tag Team Champions Ole and Arn Anderson take on Pez Whatley, Ronnie Garvin, and Nation Heavyweight Champion Terry Taylor in a Six-Man Tag Team Match, Magnum T.A. and Dusty Rhodes look to confront the Four Horsemen face-to-face. Plus, The Road Warriors and more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 23, 1985
videos.overview: With Starrcade rapidly approaching, NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair makes it clear that he intends to defeat Dusty Rhodes and retain his title. Plus, Superstar Billy Graham, Sam Houston, National Heavyweight Champion Terry Taylor, and many more in action on this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 30, 1985
videos.overview: Relive some of the most exciting matchups and highlights from Starrcade '85 including Terry Taylor defending his National Heavyweight Championship against "Nature Boy" Buddy Landel and Sam Houston battling Krusher Khrushchev for the vacant Mid-Atlantic Heavyweight Championship. Plus, The Road Warriors and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 07, 1985
videos.overview: While controversy abounds regarding Dusty Rhodes defeating Ric Flair for the NWA World Heavyweight Title at Starrcade, Tully Blanchard and the Minnesota Wrecking Crew take to the ring to faceoff against Sam Houston, Billy Jack Haynes, and United States Heavyweight Champion Magnum T.A. in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, The Road Warriors and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 14, 1985
videos.overview: With the United States Heavyweight Championship in the hands of Magnum T.A. and the National Heavyweight Championship in the hands Buddy Landel, a question arises as to who is the No. 1 Contender for Ric Flair's World Heavyweight Championship. Plus, Tully Blanchard, Pez Whatley, Manny Fernandez, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 21, 1985
videos.overview: As everyone awaits the upcoming tournament to crown a new Television Champion, Dusty Rhodes lets the world know exactly where he ranks in the title picture. Plus, Tully Blanchard, United States Heavyweight Champion Magnum T.A., World Tag Team Champions The Rock 'n' Roll Express, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 28, 1985
videos.overview: Ronnie Garvin's challenge to Ric Flair is answered as he goes one-on-one with The "Nature Boy" for his NWA World Heavyweight Championship. Plus, United States Heavyweight Champion Magnum T.A. faces off against Ole Anderson, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 04, 1986
videos.overview: With Dusty Rhodes taking out Ole Anderson and capturing the National Heavyweight Championship from Tully Blanchard thanks to Baby Doll, The Four Horsemen vow to get revenge on The American Dream and his associates. Plus, Harley Race makes his presence felt when Magnum T.A. battles The Barbarian, The Road Warriors in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 11, 1986
videos.overview: The rivalry between The Russians and The Road Warriors escalates when Krusher Khrushchev defends his Mid-Atlantic Heavyweight Championship against Sam Houston in the main event. Plus, National Heavyweight Champion Dusty Rhodes promises to take out another member of The Four Horsemen, The Midnight Express in action, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 18, 1986
videos.overview: As Ronnie Garvin sets his sights on putting an end Ric Flair's reign as NWA World Heavyweight Champion, The Nature Boy resolves to show him why he is called 'the dirtiest player in the game'. Plus, Jimmy Valiant, Nikita Koloff, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, and many more in action on this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 25, 1986
videos.overview: While the rivalry between Ronnie Garvin and NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair continues, Jim Cornette vows that his Midnight Express will take the World Tag Team Championship from their longtime rivals, The Rock 'n' Roll Express. Plus, Tully Blanchard & Arn Anderson take on Don Kernodle & the Italian Stallion, Baron Von Raschke, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 08, 1986
videos.overview: Though the World Tag Team Championship is now in the hands of Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, their rivalry with The Rock 'n' Roll Express is far from over. Plus, Baron Von Raschke, World Television Champion Arn Anderson, The Road Warriors, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 15, 1986
videos.overview: The Four Horsemen's Arn Anderson defends his Television Championship against Sam Houston. Plus Dusty Rhodes gives The Rock 'n' Roll Express a present to rattle Jim Cornette's cage, Magnum T.A. in action, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 22, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, Ric Flair changes the face of Professional Wrestling as he unveils a new version of the NWA World Heavyweight Championship. Plus, several tag teams prepare for news of the upcoming Jim Crockett Sr., Memorial Cup, United States Heavyweight Champion Magnum T.A. in action, and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 01, 1986
videos.overview: On a night where NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair competes in the main event, Arn Anderson defends his World Television Championship against Ronnie Garvin. Plus, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, Tully Blanchard, United States Heavyweight Champion Magnum T.A., and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 08, 1986
videos.overview: With the National Heavyweight Championship once again in the hands of Tully Blanchard following his battle with Dusty Rhodes, The Four Horsemen celebrate the newest addition of gold to their faction while The American Dream welcomes more hard times. Plus, Ronnie Garvin, World Tag Team Champions The Midnight Express, and many more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 15, 1986
videos.overview: After weeks of anticipation, the seeds for the first ever Jim Crockett Sr., Memorial Cup are revealed along with another huge announcement on the next challenge for Ric Flair's World Heavyweight Championship. Plus, Dusty Rhodes and Magnum T.A. get some payback on The Four Horsemen, Arn Anderson defends his World Television Championship, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 22, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, The Four Horsemen prepare for the upcoming Jim Crockett Sr., Memorial Cup while Ric Flair addresses his World Heavyweight Title defense against Dusty Rhodes. Plus, The Rock 'n' Roll Express, Wahoo McDaniel, United States Heavyweight Champion Magnum T.A., and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 29, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, anticipation for the Jim Crockett Sr., Memorial Cup continues to build as several teams claim to be the number one seed. Plus, Pez Whatley explains his attack on Jimmy Valiant, Dusty Rhodes sends a message to The Four Horsemen, The Rock 'n' Roll Express in action, and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 05, 1986
videos.overview: As the road to the Jim Crockett Sr., Memorial Cup grows shorter, Ronnie Garvin gets another shot at gold as he challenges Arn Anderson for his World Television Championship in a rematch. Plus, Wahoo McDaniel, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, The Koloffs, and many more in action on this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 12, 1986
videos.overview: NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair takes to the ring as he goes one-on-one with Ricky Morton of The Rock 'n' Roll Express. Plus, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express in action in the main event, Ivan Koloff, Baron Von Raschke, and Nikita Koloff defend their Six-Man Tag Team Championship, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 19, 1986
videos.overview: Just hours away from the evening session of the Jim Crockett Sr., Memorial Cup, this edition of World Championship presents some exciting matchups including Arn Anderson defending his World Television Championship against Manny Fernandez. Plus, United Stated Heavyweight Champion Magnum T.A., Wahoo McDaniel, The Road Warriors, and many more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 26, 1986
videos.overview: With Baby Doll suffering an injury at the hands of Jim Cornette and his Midnight Express, Magnum T.A. and Dusty Rhodes promise to get payback. Despite his recent attack at the hands of NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair, Ricky Morton proves the measure of his resolve. Plus, National Heavyweight Champion Tully Blanchard and more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 10, 1986
videos.overview: While Ricky Morton continues his pursuit of Ric Flair's NWA World Heavyweight Championship, The Nature Boy and World Television Champion Arn Anderson take to the ring for tag team action. Plus, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express battles the Mulkey Brothers, Ronnie Garvin in action, and much more on this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 17, 1986
videos.overview: Along with his recent issues with Baby Doll, Jim Cornette and his Midnight Express continue to have problems with the mysterious duo known as The James Boys. Plus, The Rock 'n' Roll Express, Baron Von Raschke, Jimmy Valiant, and many more NWA stars in action on this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 24, 1986
videos.overview: While Dusty Rhodes and The Road Warriors celebrate their reign as Six-Man Tag Team Champions, The James Boys are faced with a bounty on their heads, courtesy of Jim Cornette's mama. Plus, The Four Horsemen's NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair & World Television Champion Arn Anderson take on Italian Stallion & Rocky Kernodle and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 31, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, Jim Cornette introduces his bodyguard to protect him from The James Boys, Big Bubba Rogers. Plus, a look at the contract signing between United States Heavyweight Champion Magnum T.A. and Nikita Koloff, an update on The Great American Bash, The Rock 'n' Roll Express in action, and more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 07, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, witness the dawning of a new day for The Four Horsemen in a special look at Dusty Rhodes battling Ric Flair for the NWA World Heavyweight Championship. Plus, an update on Magnum T.A. being stripped of the United States Heavyweight Title, The Rock 'n' Roll Express in action, and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 14, 1986
videos.overview: As the road to The Great American Bash continues, The Minnesota Wrecking Crew returns to tag team competition to show everyone that The Four Horsemen are back. Plus, The Russians compete in a Six-Man Tag Team Match, The Warlord makes his in-ring debut, and much more on this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 21, 1986
videos.overview: Things continue to heat up on the road to The Great American Bash as The Four Horsemen show The Road Warriors the meaning of strength in numbers. Plus, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, Jimmy Valiant, Magnum T.A., and many more stars of the NWA are in action on this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 28, 1986
videos.overview: With the next stop on The Great American Bash Tour right around the corner, the members of The Four Horsemen send a message to all their enemies to let them know what awaits them. Plus, Jim Cornette decides to help host the program once again, National Heavyweight Champion Tully Blanchard in action, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 12, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, The Great American Bash Tour is in full swing as Jim Cornette's Midnight Express defend their World Tag Team Championships against The Road Warriors. Plus, The Rock 'n' Roll Express and Dusty Rhodes ready to take on The Four Horsemen in a Bunkhouse Match, Ronnie Garvin faces Black Bart, and more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 19, 1986
videos.overview: The Great American Bash Tour continues as The Rock 'n' Roll Express faces off with The Four Horsemen's Ole and Arn Anderson in an incredible Tag Team Match. Plus, National Heavyweight Champion Tully Blanchard battles Sam Houston, Dusty Rhodes and Magnum T.A. take on Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, and more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 02, 1986
videos.overview: On a very special edition of World Championship Wrestling, Tony Schiavone gets the fans of the NWA ready for the grand finale of The Great American Bash tour with some memorable interviews, exciting updates, and incredible highlights of all the action and events thus far!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 09, 1986
videos.overview: Despite capturing the NWA World Heavyweight Championship from Ric Flair, Dusty Rhodes' problems with The Four Horsemen are far from over as they continue to call out The American Dream. Plus, Jim Cornette promises a surprise for Baby Doll, Wahoo McDaniel and Sam Houston battle Black Bart and Thunderfoot, and more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 16, 1986
videos.overview: With the NWA World Heavyweight Championship back around the waist of Ric Flair, The Four Horsemen are once again on top of the wrestling world as The Nature Boy gives special gift to J. J. Dillon. Plus, The Rock 'n' Roll Express, Dick Murdoch, The Road Warriors, and many more in action on this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 23, 1986
videos.overview: While the world buzzes over Baby Doll turning on Dusty Rhodes and leaving him for NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair, an old friend of The American Dream makes his intentions for "The Nature Boy" known. Plus, Tully Blanchard and The Minnesota Wrecking Crew compete in Six-Man Tag Team action and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 30, 1986
videos.overview: On a night where NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair takes to the ring for singles action, tensions between The Four Horsemen and Dusty Rhodes reach a boiling point when friends of The American Dream get involved. Plus, The Kansas Jayhawks, United States Heavyweight Champion Nikita Koloff, and more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 06, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, Dusty Rhodes and Magnum T.A. begin a bid to take the United States Tag Team Championships away from The Russians. Plus, The Kansas Jayhawks take on The Minnesota Wrecking Crew, National Heavyweight Champion Wahoo McDaniel in action, and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 20, 1986
videos.overview: With Jim Cornette and his Midnight Express seriously injuring Road Warrior Animal in a vicious assault, the complexion of United States Tag Team Tournament may be changed. Plus, Dick Murdoch and Ronnie Garvin battle the Mulkey Brothers, Baron Von Raschke in action, and more on this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 27, 1986
videos.overview: While every one awaits the United States Tag Team Title Tournament, Dick Murdoch lets Dusty Rhodes and Magnum T.A. know that there are no friends when it comes to championship gold. Plus, Jimmy Valiant, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, United States Heavyweight Champion Nikita Koloff, and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct 04, 1986
videos.overview: Tully Blanchard and The Minnesota Wrecking represent The Four Horsemen in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, Magnum T.A. and many more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 11, 1986
videos.overview: The Paul Jones Army takes over this edition of World Championship Wrestling as both Ravishing Rick Rude and Manny Fernandez compete in singles competition. Plus, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, Brad Armstrong, The Four Horsemen's Tully Blanchard, and many more NWA stars in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 18, 1986
videos.overview: As the world eagerly anticipates the upcoming news regarding Starrcade '86, Jimmy Valiant proves what lengths he will go to in order to get Paul Jones out of his hair. Plus, NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair, The Minnesota Wrecking Crew, Mid-Atlantic Heavyweight Champion Ronnie Garvin, and many more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct 25, 1986
videos.overview: The Road Warriors issue a tall challenge to Jim Cornette's Midnight Express at Starrcade '86. Dusty Rhodes comments on Magnum T.A. accident.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 08, 1986
videos.overview: While Jim Cornette and his Midnight Express prepare to reach new heights against The Road Warriors going into Starrcade '86, NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair addresses his upcoming title defense against Nikita Koloff. Plus, Arn Anderson, Brad Armstrong, Gorgeous Jimmy Garvin, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 15, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling the Midnight Express and Jim Cornette brag about their recent assault on Ron Garvin. The Four Horsemen exude confidence as Starrcade '86 rapidly approaches. Plus Ravishing Rick Rude, Tully Blanchard, and more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 22, 1986
videos.overview: On this final edition of World Championship Wrestling before the stars of the NWA collided at Starrcade, Tony Schiavone provides all the news leading up to the big event. Plus the Midnight Express, Arn Anderson, Rick Rude and more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 29, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling the stars of the NWA focus on the upcoming Bunkhouse Stampede. Plus the Midnight Express, Shaska Whatley, Bill Dundee and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 06, 1986
videos.overview: The Rock 'n' Roll Express put the NWA World Tag Team Championship on the line against "Ravishing" Rick Rude & "Ragin' Bull" Manny Fernandez in the main event. Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair speaks after his successful title defense at Starcade. Plus Barry Windham, Arn Anderson, Tully Blanchard and much more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 13, 1986
videos.overview: The Superpowers Dusty Rhodes & Nikita Koloff will not be intimidated by the Four Horsemen. The new NWA Tag Team Champions Rick Rude & Manny Fernandez showcase their dominance. Plus, The Rock 'n' Roll Express, Nikita Koloff, Tully Blanchard, the Midnight Express, Road Warriors, and much more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 20, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling the stars of the NWA are in action. NWA World Tag Team Champions, Rick Rude and Manny Fernandez, take on the Mulkey Brothers. Plus Wahoo McDaniel, Tully Blanchard, the Minnesota Wrecking Crew, Barry Windham, the Road Warriors and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 27, 1986
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling the stars of the NWA are in action. Barry Windham and Ron Garvin put their US Tag Team Championships on the line against The Midnight Express. Plus The Road Warriors, Dick Murdoch, Tully Blanchard, Jimmy Garvin and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 03, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling the stars of the NWA are in action. Ivan Koloff introduces his new Russian monster, Vladimir Petrov. Plus The Rock 'n 'Roll Express, Nikita Koloff, The Road Warriors, The Midnight Express and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 10, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling the stars of the NWA are in action. Nikita Koloff is not impressed with Ivan and his new monster, Vladimir Petrov. Barry Windham and Ron Garvin take on the Mulkey Brothers. Plus, The Road Warriors, The Rock 'n' Roll Express, Tully Blanchard, Bill Dundee and many more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan 17, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling Dusty Rhodes has strong words for the Russians and Lex Luger makes his debut.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan 24, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling the stars of the NWA are in action. Lex Luger makes his desire to be a Four Horsemen clear.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan 31, 1987
videos.overview: On this World Championship Wrestling Tully Blanchard defends the World TV Title and Lex Luger strengthens his bonds to the Horsemen.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 07, 1987
videos.overview: The NWA takes you across the country on Supertowns on the Superstation. Exclusive matches include Dusty Rhodes taking on Tully Blanchard, Barry Windham facing Arn Anderson, and Ric Flair defending the World Heavyweight Championship against Nikita Koloff. Plus, The Midnight Express and The Road Warriors in a Scaffold Match and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 14, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling the stars of the NWA are in action. The fall out from Dick Murdoch treacherous attack on Nikita Koloff. Plus Jimmy Valiant, The Midnight Express, Kansas Jayhawks, Lex Luger and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb 21, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling The Four Horsemen team up in the main event as a show of unity and dominance.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 28, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling the stars of the NWA are in action. Tensions between The Four Horsemen reach a boiling point, when an original member makes a bold stand. Plus Nikita Koloff, Barry Windham, Bobby Eaton and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar 07, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling Ole Anderson's status as a Four Horsemen is in question. Denny Brown and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 14, 1987
videos.overview: The Four Horsemen embrace the old adage "out with the old, in with the new" when J.J. Dillon introduces the newest member of the elite group. Mike Rotundo returns to the NWA, Jim Corrnette taunts the Garvin brothers. Plus, Rock 'n' Roll Express, Lazor-Tron, Midnight Express, Barbarian, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar 21, 1987
videos.overview: The Four Horsemen move forward without Ole Anderson as the new addition of Lex Luger partners with Arn Anderson for tag team action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 28, 1987
videos.overview: On this exciting edition of World Championship Wrestling, the build for the Jim Crockett Sr., Memorial Cup continues to build as several team make their stake in the tournament. Plus, Arn Anderson battles Tim Horner, The Rock 'n' Roll Express in tag team action, Mulkey-Mania runs wild and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 04, 1987
videos.overview: While several tag team combinations prepare for the Jim Crockett Sr. Memorial Cup, Jim Cornette decides to upgrade his Midnight Express by introducing a new and more youthful replacement for the team's weak link. Plus, Tully Blanchard calls out Ole Anderson, Big Bubba Rogers in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 11, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, Ric Flair's persistent advances to acquire Precious end up causing problems for The Nature Boy while Gorgeous Jimmy Garvin sets his sights on attaining his World Heavyweight Championship. Plus, The Four Horsemen continue to threaten Ole Anderson, Tim Horner in action, and more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 18, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, recap on recent events with highlights from the Jim Crockett Sr., Memorial Cup while NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair takes to the ring for singles action. Plus, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, International Tag Team Champions The Road Warriors, and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 02, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, the tournament to crown new United States Tag Team Champions continues as Bob and Brad Armstrong take on The New Breed in a First Round match. Plus, Jim Cornette's mouth gets him in trouble with Ronnie Garvin, Lex Luger in action, and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 09, 1987
videos.overview: Having turned up the heat in his rivalry with Ronnie Garvin, Jim Cornette runs scared as Garvin vows to get some payback on The Louisville Lip. Plus, World Tag Team Champions Rick Rude and Manny Fernandez make things personal with The Road Warriors, The Four Horsemen compete in Six-Man Tag Team action, and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 16, 1987
videos.overview: On this special edition of World Championship Wrestling, the NWA United States Tag Team Championships are on the line as Jim Cornette's Midnight Express takes on the duo of Barry Windham and Ronnie Garvin in an exciting matchup for the gold!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 23, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, the upcoming 'Winner Take All' match between Dusty Rhodes and Tully Blanchard for World Television Championship is made official. Plus, The Fabulous Freebirds compete in a Six-Man Tag Team match, Lex Luger in action, and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 30, 1987
videos.overview: With everyone speculating whether or not Dusty Rhodes will be able to compete against Tully Blanchard in a 'Winner Take All' Television Championship match, an old friend pledges his support for The American Dream. Plus, Jim Cornette takes legal action against Jim Crockett Promotions, Lex Luger in action, and more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 06, 1987
videos.overview: Just 24 hours away from The Four Horsemen's battle with The Fabulous Freebirds at The Omni, Ric Flair and Lex Luger demonstrate their ability to effectively compete as a unit as they team up for tag team action. Plus, World Tag Team Champions The Rock 'n' Roll Express, Dusty Rhodes, and many more on this edition of World Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 13, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, witness the controversial 'Winner Takes All' matchup where Dusty Rhodes battled Tully Blanchard for the World Television Championship in The Omni. Plus, The Four Horsemen compete in a Six-Man Tag Team match, Gorgeous Jimmy Garvin in action, and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 20, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, more matches for The Great American Bash Tour are announced including the addition of painful stipulation to Tully Blanchard's match against Dusty Rhodes. Plus, Arn Anderson, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, Gorgeous Jimmy Garvin, and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 27, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, The Great American Bash Tour kicks off with a special 'Dream Match' as Ronnie and Gorgeous Jimmy Garvin battle The Four Horsemen's Dream Team of Lex Luger and NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair. Plus, United States Heavyweight Champion NIkita Koloff, Barry Windham, and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 04, 1987
videos.overview: Just hours before their team competes in a WarGames match at The Great American Bash, The Four Horsemen's Arn Anderson, Lex Luger, J.J. Dillon, and Television Champion Tully Blanchard look to warm up by competing in a series of matchups. Plus, Ron Simmons, Dory Funk Jr., Western States Heritage Champion Barry Windham, and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 11, 1987
videos.overview: Following The Four Horsemen's defeat to Dusty Rhodes, Nikita Koloff, and The Road Warriors in the first ever WarGames match, James J. Dillon enlists a special asset to replace him in their next battle. Plus, The Fabulous Freebirds, Bugsy McGraw, Dr. Death Steve Williams, and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 18, 1987
videos.overview: As The Great American Bash Tour nears, this edition of World Championship Wrestling takes a look at Ric Flair defending his World Heavyweight Title against Gorgeous Jimmy Garvin inside a Steel Cage, as well as the Steel Cage match between Lex Luger and Nikita Koloff for the United States Heavyweight Title. All this and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 25, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair vows payback on Ronnie Garvin when it is revealed that his 'Dream Date' with Precious turned into a family affair. Plus, World Tag Team Champions The Rock 'n' Roll Express, Western States Heritage Champion Barry Windham, and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 01, 1987
videos.overview: Following a tremendous Great American Bash Tour, tensions between The Rock 'n' Roll Express and The Four Horsemen explode when Ricky Morton takes exception to comments from World Television Champion Tully Blanchard. Plus, United States Heavyweight Champion Lex Luger, Gorgeous Jimmy Garvin, and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 08, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, stars from the Universal Wrestling Federation including UWF Heavyweight Champion Dr. Death Steve Williams, The Fabulous Freebirds, and more compete before the fans of NWA. Plus, The Four Horsemen, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, and many more NWA stars in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 15, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, the rivalry between Ronnie Garvin and NWA World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair is highlighted as Garvin continues his pursuit of The Nature Boy's title. Plus, Ivan Koloff, Western States Heritage Champion Barry Windham, and many more in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 22, 1987
videos.overview: On this special edition of World Championship Wrestling, several stars from all over the wrestling world compete before the fans of the NWA. Plus, The Fabulous Freebirds take on The Thunderfoots, Kevin Sullivan looks to recruit Dusty Rhodes into coming back to Florida to help him, and much more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 29, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, The Four Horsemen's Tully Blanchard defends his World Television Championship against Nikita Koloff in an incredible matchup. Plus, The Barbarian, United States Heavyweight Champion Lex Luger, Gorgeous Jimmy Garvin, and many more NWA stars in action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 05, 1987
videos.overview: While questions abound over Dusty Rhodes' new move, World Television Champion Nikita Koloff makes his presence felt when United States Champions The Midnight Express compete in the main event. Plus, Ronnie Garvin prepares for a shot at Ric Flair's World Heavyweight Championship, Arn Anderson in action, and more!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 12, 1987
videos.overview: On this edition of World Championship Wrestling, United States Tag Team Champion Bobby Eaton challenges Nikita Koloff for his World Television Championship. Plus, Barry Windham defends his Western States Heritage Title against Arn Anderson, a stinging look at a rising superstar, and much more action!

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 19, 1987
videos.overview: The Four Horsemen's Tully Blanchard & Arn Anderson challenge The Rock 'n' Roll Express for their World Tag Team Championship in a No Disqualification main event. Plus, Lex Luger defends his United States Heavyweight Championship against Western States Heritage Champion Barry Windham, The Barbarian in action, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 26, 1987
videos.overview: Ric Flair defends his NWA World Heavyweight Championship against Ronnie Garvin. Tully Blanchard, The Sheepherders, Bugsy McGraw, and many more are in action. Plus, Florida Heavyweight Champion Mike Rotunda competes in the main event.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 03, 1987
videos.overview: Nikita Koloff defends the NWA World Television Championship against El Negro in the main event. UWF World Television Champion Terry Taylor looks to make a bold statement. The Four Horsemen continue to reign supreme with United States Champion Lex Luger and World Tag Team Champions Arn Anderson and Tully Blanchard in action. All this and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 10, 1987
videos.overview: Despite the UWF Commissioner's request for UWF World Television Champion Terry Taylor to return the stolen NWA World Television Championship to Nikita Koloff, Taylor resolves to defend both titles in the main event. World Heavyweight Champion Ron Garvin battles Mike Force. Plus, International Tag Team Champions The Road Warriors and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 17, 1987
videos.overview: Sting makes a splash that will change the NWA forever. Terry Taylor puts the UWF World Television Championship on the line against Larry Stephens. World Tag Team Champions Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard take on Rocky King & George South. Plus, World Heavyweight Champion Ron Garvin, The Rock 'n' Roll Express, Mighty Wilbur, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 24, 1987
videos.overview: Dusty Rhodes promises to put his career on the line in an effort to avenge Johnny Weaver. After finding out that his Midnight Express will meet The Rock 'n' Roll Express in a Scaffold Match, Jim Cornette threatens to take legal action. Plus, Florida Heavyweight Champion Mike Rotunda, Kevin Sullivan, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 31, 1987
videos.overview: Paul Ellering sits down with James J. Dillon to sign the contract for The Road Warriors to challenge Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard for the World Tag Team Championship at Starrcade '87. With an opportunity to reclaim the World Heavyweight Championship from Ron Garvin approaching, Ric Flair addresses the enemies of The Four Horsemen.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 07, 1987
videos.overview: Sting continues to make waves by taking to the ring for one-on-one action. With their eyes set on dominating the tag team division, UWF Tag Team Champions The Sheepherders compete in the main event. Plus, Tony Schiavone presents more news from the Starrcade Control Center, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 14, 1987
videos.overview: Johnny Weaver finds his place in the upcoming Steel Cage Match between Dusty Rhodes and United States Champion Lex Luger. After making his first appearance on World Championship Wrestling, Larry Zbyszko puts every champion on notice. Plus, Shaska Whatley in action, Ric Flair sends a message to World Heavyweight Champion Ron Garvin, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 21, 1987
videos.overview: With Starrcade '87 rapidly approaching, Dusty Rhodes vows to walk out of the big event with Lex Luger's United States Championship. Jim Cornette's Midnight Express in action. Magnum TA joins Tony Schiavone at the Starrcade Control Center. Plus, International Tag Team Champions The Road Warriors in action, Sting faces Cougar Jay, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 28, 1987
videos.overview: As Ric Flair begins his fifth reign as World Heavyweight Champion in the aftermath of Starrcade, newcomer Sting makes "The Nature Boy" aware of his golden intentions. Western States Heritage Champion Barry Windham, Mighty Wilbur & Ricky Santana take on Ivan Koloff, Warlord & The Barbarian. Plus, Ron Simmons, The Fabulous Freebirds, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 05, 1987
videos.overview: The Four Horsemen clash with The Fabulous Freebirds, as Michael P.S. Hayes takes to the ring to go one-on-one with World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair in the main event. Plus, Sting in action, Mark Star challenges Nikita Koloff for the World Television Championship, Larry Zbyszko battles Western States Heritage Champion Barry Windham, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 12, 1987
videos.overview: After going against his allies in The Four Horsemen during a Bunkhouse Stampede, United States Champion Lex Luger makes a decision to take his career in a different direction. United States Tag Team Team Champions The Midnight Express battle the team of George South & Italian Stallion. Plus, Sting, Ron Garvin, The Fabulous Freebirds, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 19, 1987
videos.overview: While problems between Lex Luger and The Four Horsemen continue, World Tag Team Champions Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard look to prove that they have never been stronger. With his recent success in the Bunkhouse Stampedes causing a stir, Sting partners with Ricky Morton. Plus, Larry Zbyszko, Florida Heavyweight Champion Mike Rotunda, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 26, 1987
videos.overview: Jim Cornette's Midnight Express put the United States Tag Team Championship on the line in a match against World Television Champion Nikita Koloff & United States Champion Dusty Rhodes. Lex Luger sends a message to Arn Anderson. Plus, "Hot Stuff" Eddie Gilbert, UWF Heavyweight Champion "Dr. Death" Steve Williams, Sting, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 02, 1988
videos.overview: The ongoing rivalry between Lex Luger and The Four Horsemen explodes when Arn Anderson goes one-on-one with former World Heavyweight Champion Ron Garvin in the main event. Plus, many of the NWA's top stars are in action, including Larry Zbyszko, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, World Television Champion Nikita Koloff, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 09, 1988
videos.overview: Sting partners with Barry Windham for tag team action. After showing his skills in the ring, Ron Simmons vows to make history. Plus, Nikita Koloff puts the World Television Championship on the line, The Sheepherders take on Mike Jackson & Italian Stallion, an update on Mighty Wilbur's recent injury in the Bunkhouse Stampedes, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 16, 1988
videos.overview: Jim Cornette leads Dick Murdoch to challenge Nikita Koloff for the World Television Championship in a memorable contest. Plus, Ron Simmons, The Powers of Pain, The Rock 'n' Roll Express, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 23, 1988
videos.overview: Amidst his continuing problems with The Four Horsemen, Lex Luger takes a ringside seat to witness Barry Windham defend the Western States Heritage Championship against Tully Blanchard. Sting's recent success leads him to call out World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair. Plus, Ron Garvin, The Rock 'n' Roll Express, Warlord, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 30, 1988
videos.overview: Following his recent return to assist Lex Luger against The Four Horsemen, Ole Anderson makes his intentions known to the world. Jim Cornette receives more than he bargained for when he agrees to give Misty Blue some in-ring lessons. After calling out World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair, Sting makes an impact at the expense of J.J. Dillon.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 06, 1988
videos.overview: Things take an unexpected turn when World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair comes face-to-face with Sting. Following his recent humiliation at the hands of Misty Blue, Jim Cornette sends a message to Dusty Rhodes and his allies. Plus, The Road Warriors meet The Powers of Pain in a Bench Press Contest, Lex Luger partners with Barry Windham, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 13, 1988
videos.overview: Alongside Lex Luger and Barry Windham, Sting continues his pursuit of World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair and his Four Horsemen. While his partner recuperates from an injury, Road Warrior Hawk takes to the ring to face two opponents in a Handicap Match. Shane Douglas faces George South. Mike Rotunda defends the Florida Heavyweight Championship.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 20, 1988
videos.overview: New Six-Man Tag Team Champions The Powers of Pain and Ivan Koloff take to the ring for action. Ron Simmons gets on the wrong side of The Four Horsemen. Plus, Lex Luger & Barry Windham compete, "Hot Stuff" Eddie Gilbert goes one-on-one with George South, an update on Sting crashing the party of World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 27, 1988
videos.overview: The world waits in anticipation to hear news of the 1988 Jim Crockett Sr. Memorial Cup Tag Team Tournament. Despite suffering from recent injuries, Road Warrior Animal shows the measure of his resolve. Plus, Sting, Western States Heritage Champion Larry Zbyszko, World Tag Team Champions Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 05, 1988
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair and World Tag Team Champions Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard compete in a Six-Man Tag Team Match main event. Plus, news on the upcoming Clash of the Champions, Mike Rotunda defends the World Television Championship against Ricky Santana, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 12, 1988
videos.overview: With Sting set to challenge Ric Flair for the World Heavyweight Championship at Clash of the Champions, "The Nature Boy" doubts the ability of his opponent. Jimmy Garvin challenges Mike Rotunda for the World Television Championship. Plus, Jim Cornette lobbies for his Midnight Express to have a higher seed in the Jim Crockett Sr. Memorial Cup.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 19, 1988
videos.overview: Sting continues his pursuit of World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair. The Fantastics are given a chance to challenge The Midnight Express for the United States Tag Team Championship at Clash of the Champions. Al Perez sets his sights on Dusty Rhodes. Plus, many of the teams scheduled to compete in the Jim Crockett Sr. Memorial Cup are in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 26, 1988
videos.overview: Controversy abounds when Dusty Rhodes comes to the aid of Magnum T.A. during an assault at the hands of Tully Blanchard and J.J. Dillon. The Fantastics unite for some in-ring competition. Plus, Sting goes one-on-one with Max McGyver, Ron Simmons in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 02, 1988
videos.overview: After nearly capturing the World Heavyweight Title from Ric Flair at Clash of the Champions, Sting lets the world know that his rivalry with "The Nature Boy" is far from over. While preparing for the Jim Crockett Sr. Memorial Cup, several top tag teams are in action, including The Fantastics, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, and The Sheepherders.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 09, 1988
videos.overview: On a night where the fate of Dusty Rhodes' in-ring future is finally decided, a masked avenger rides into the NWA in search of justice for The American Dream. With several teams preparing for the Jim Crockett Sr. Memorial Cup, Arn Anderson and Tully Blanchard show why they hold the top seed in the tournament. Plus, Sting and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 16, 1988
videos.overview: As the world buzzes over the identity of the mysterious Midnight Rider, J.J. Dillon resolves to take matters into his own hands. While preparing for the Jim Crockett Sr. Memorial Cup, Lex Luger takes to the ring for some singles competition. The rivalry between The Fantastics and United States Tag Team Champions escalates.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 23, 1988
videos.overview: The structure of the Jim Crockett Sr. Memorial Cup is drastically altered when Barry Windham & Lex Luger defend the World Tag Team Championships against Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard. Suspicion continues to follow the mysterious Midnight Rider as he gears up for action. Plus, The Fantastics vow to whip Jim Cornette into shape and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 30, 1988
videos.overview: After turning on Lex Luger to help Arn Anderson and Tully Blanchard capture the World Tag Team Championships and join The Four Horsemen, Barry Windham vows to become the United States Champion. Plus, highlights from the Jim Crockett Sr. Memorial Cup, Sting in action, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 07, 1988
videos.overview: After Jim Cornette's premature celebration for his Midnight Express being awarded the United States Tag Team Championship goes south, The Fantastics show The Louisville Lip that revenge truly is sweet. J.J. Dillon objects to the recent reinstatement of Dusty Rhodes. Plus, Sting, Al Perez, Barry Windham, The Powers of Pain, and many more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 14, 1988
videos.overview: While Tully Blanchard prepares to battle the recently reinstated Dusty Rhodes in a Bull Rope Match, The Four Horsemen send a message to everyone standing in their way. Following his recent humiliation at the hands of The Fantastics, Jim Cornette vows that his Midnight Express will humble the duo of Tommy Rogers & Bobby Fulton. All this and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 21, 1988
videos.overview: While preparing for the upcoming event at The Omni, the Superstars of the NWA compete in exciting action. From The Varsity Club's Mike Rotunda putting the World Television Championship on the line to Sting taking to the ring for singles competition, this edition of World Championship Wrestling features the finest in sports-entertainment.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 28, 1988
videos.overview: After recovering from injury, Mighty Wilbur returns to action to team with Ron Garvin. Plus, Sting partners with "Dr. Death" Steve Williams & Nikita Koloff for a Six-Man Tag Team Match, Jim Cornette vows to keep his Midnight Express from competing in the NWA, Kevin Sullivan promises to create a structure to get even with Jimmy Garvin, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 04, 1988
videos.overview: World Tag Team Champions Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard take to the ring for main event competition. Kevin Sullivan explains the rules of his new concept, The Tower of Doom Match. Plus, Mike Rotunda defends the Television Championship, Dusty Rhodes sends a message to Barry Windham, The Midnight Express gets some payback on The Fantastics, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 11, 1988
videos.overview: Lex Luger waits to pass judgment on World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair. Kevin Sullivan finally explains his relationship with Precious. United States Tag Team Champions The Fantastics vow to get revenge on The Midnight Express. Plus, Arn Anderson, Sting, "Dr. Death" Steve Williams, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 18, 1988
videos.overview: Jim Cornette's Midnight Express partner with The Sheepherders for an Eight Man Tag Team Match main event. Plus, World Tag Team Champions Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard in action, Precious denies Kevin Sullivan's recent allegations, a look at the rivalry between Dusty Rhodes and Barry Windham, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 25, 1988
videos.overview: Ric Flair shows no fear while preparing to defend the World Heavyweight Championship against Lex Luger. To avoid being humiliated by The Fantastics, Jim Cornette appeals Jim Crockett, Jr's better nature. Plus, The Road Warriors, Sting, United States Heavyweight Champion Barry Windham, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 02, 1988
videos.overview: Dusty Rhodes and Lex Luger set their sights on taking both United States and World Heavyweight Championships from The Four Horsemen. Plus, The Rock 'n' Roll Express return to action, Mike Rotunda defends the World Television Championship, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 09, 1988
videos.overview: Less than a day away from challenging Ric Flair for the World Heavyweight Championship in Baltimore at The Great American Bash '88, Lex Luger shows everyone that he is determined to take "The Nature Boy"s gold. Barry Windham takes to the ring for singles action. Plus, Sting, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 16, 1988
videos.overview: After turning on Dusty Rhodes to help Barry Windham remain United States Champion, Ron Garvin finds himself faced with new enemies. Jim Cornette rides high thanks to his Midnight Express once again becoming United States Tag Team Champions. Plus, The Road Warriors, Sting and "Dr. Death" Steve Williams, Nikita Koloff, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 23, 1988
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair takes to the ring for main event competition. With his Midnight Express riding high as United States Tag Team Champions, Jim Cornette issues a challenge to Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard. Plus, Sting partners with Nikita Koloff and "Dr. Death" Steve Williams for a Six-Man Tag Team Match and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 30, 1988
videos.overview: Tensions between The Four Horsemen and United States Tag Team Champions The Midnight Express escalate when Jim Cornette continues to challenge Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard for the World Tag Team Championship. Plus, Sting sends a message to United States Heavyweight Champion Barry Windham and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 06, 1988
videos.overview: While Lex Luger looks forward to once again challenging Ric Flair for the World Heavyweight Championship, "The Nature Boy" vows that it will be the last time that "The Total Package" receives an opportunity for his title. With Dick Murdoch by his side, Dusty Rhodes sends a message to Al Perez and Ron Garvin. Plus, the Four Horsemen and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 13, 1988
videos.overview: With the likes of Lex Luger, Sting, and Jim Cornette's Midnight Express looking to take their championship gold, The Four Horsemen remind their enemies exactly who they are. Ricky Morton finds a new ally in the form of Nikita Koloff. Plus, United States Heavyweight Champion Barry Windham, Al Perez, The Varsity Club, and many more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 20, 1988
videos.overview: Two major titles are on the line, as The Varsity Club's Rick Steiner and Mike Rotunda defend both the Florida Heavyweight and World Television Championships. United States Tag Team Champions The Midnight Express take to the ring for action. Plus, Ricky Morton in singles competition, Al Perez continues to pursue a match with Dusty Rhodes, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Aug. 27, 1988
videos.overview: The ongoing rivalry between Jim Cornette's Midnight Express and The Four Horsemen reaches new heights following an alleged assault on Bobby Eaton. Sting sends a message to United States Champion Barry Windham. Plus, Ricky Morton and Nikita Koloff team up, Brad Armstrong in action, words from World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 03, 1988
videos.overview: As their rivalry continues, both United States Tag Team Champions The Midnight Express and World Tag Team Champions Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard compete. With Sting continuing to threaten his reign as United States Champion, Barry Windham takes to the ring for singles action. Plus, Ron Simmons, The Fantastics, Al Perez, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 10, 1988
videos.overview: As Ric Flair's World Heavyweight Championship defense against Lex Luger approaches, a Special Guest Referee is introduced to officiate the contest. Ron Simmons answers Gary Hart's recent challenges. Plus, Ricky Morton partners with Brad Armstrong for a tag team match, Western States Heritage Champion Larry Zbyszko in action, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 17, 1988
videos.overview: Ron Simmons goes one-on-one with Kevin Sullivan in a Dog Collar Match. Following their recent victory over Arn Anderson & Tully Blanchard, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express rides high as the United States and World Tag Team Champions. Plus, Sting, The Fantastics, United States Heavyweight Champion Barry Windham, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Sep. 24, 1988
videos.overview: Several top stars of the National Wrestling Alliance are in action, including Sting, United States Champion Barry Windham, and World Tag Team Champions The Midnight Express. Plus, news on the upcoming tournament for the United States Tag Team Championship, Ivan Koloff talks about his issues with Paul Jones on Magnum T.A.'s Straight Talk, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 01, 1988
videos.overview: Ric Flair sends a message to Sting, Lex Luger, and everyone else looking to end his reign as World Heavyweight Champion. Alongside Sir Oliver Humperdink, newcomer Bam Bam Bigelow continues to impress. Plus, Rick Steiner defends the World Television Championship for Mike Rotunda, World Tag Team Champions The Midnight Express in action, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 08, 1988
videos.overview: Speculation runs rampant about the plans for Sir Oliver Humperdink's newest acquisition, Bam Bam Bigelow. With teams like The Road Warriors looking for an opportunity at their World Tag Team Championship, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express show why they hold the gold. Plus, Ron Simmons, Nikita Koloff and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 15, 1988
videos.overview: The world buzzes over Sting and what lead to his recent injury at the hands of The Road Warriors. Sir Oliver Humperdink promises to lead Bam Bam Bigelow to the World Heavyweight Championship. Plus, several top stars of the NWA are in action, including Ron Simmons, Kevin Sullivan, World Tag Team Champions The Midnight Express, and many more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 22, 1988
videos.overview: After footage of The Road Warriors' brutal attack on Sting is shown to the world, Dusty Rhodes lets his fellow Six-Man Tag Team Champions know that he is ashamed of their actions. Plus, Mike Rotunda defends the World Television Championship in the main event, The Russian Assassins in action, and Magnum T.A. conducts an interview with Lex Luger.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Oct. 29, 1988
videos.overview: The Road Warriors receive a message of vengeance from the man they put out of action, Sting. Plus, several top stars of the National Wrestling Alliance take to the ring for exciting competition, including The Fantastics, United States Heavyweight Champion Barry Windham, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 05, 1988
videos.overview: Bam Bam Bigelow and Sir Oliver Humperdink issue a word of warning to United States Heavyweight Champion Barry Windham and World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair. Plus, Ron Simmons and Rip Morgan meet in one-on-one action, Mike Rotunda defends the World Television Championship, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 12, 1988
videos.overview: After making a huge statement at the expense of Jim Cornette and his Midnight Express, Paul E. Dangerously reintroduces the world to The Original Midnight Express of Randy Rose & Dennis Condrey. Bam Bam Bigelow targets United States Champion Barry Windham. Plus, World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair in action, Lex Luger, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 19, 1988
videos.overview: Sting & Lex Luger team up for in-ring competition. While their rivalry with Paul E. Dangerously's Original Midnight Express continues, Jim Cornette and his Midnight Express vow to take out Dennis Condrey. Plus, Rick Steiner's problems with The Varsity Club are far from over, Abdullah The Butcher in action, news on Starrcade '88, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Nov. 26, 1988
videos.overview: World Tag Team Champions The Road Warriors promise to get revenge on Lex Luger and Sting. Barry Windham dares Bam Bam Bigelow to challenge him for the United States Heavyweight Championship. Plus, Paul E. Dangerously's Original Midnight Express, Nikita Koloff, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 03, 1988
videos.overview: After suffering a serious injury during an altercation with The Road Warriors, Dusty Rhodes vows to get an eye for an eye. United States Heavyweight Champion Barry Windham gets his hands on Bam Bam Bigelow. Plus, World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair takes to the ring for singles action, Sting looks to return to his old ways, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 10, 1988
videos.overview: Several top stars of the NWA take to the ring for action, including Bam Bam Bigelow, World Tag Team Champions The Road Warriors, and United States Champion Barry Windham. Plus, Rick Steiner gets into the holiday spirit, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express send a message to Paul E. Dangerously's Original Midnight Express, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 17, 1988
videos.overview: Lex Luger sets the record straight on why he asked for a No Disqualification Match against Ric Flair for the World Heavyweight Championship. World Tag Team Champions The Road Warriors send a message to Sting and Dusty Rhodes. Plus, United States Champion Barry Windham, Paul E. Dangerously, The Original Midnight Express, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 24, 1988
videos.overview: United States Heavyweight Champion Barry Windham goes one-on-one with "Hot Stuff" Eddie Gilbert. Plus, Junkyard Dog partners with Ivan Koloff & Rick Steiner for a Six-Man Tag Team Match, United States Tag Team Champions The Fantastics take to the ring, Sting in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Dec. 31, 1988
videos.overview: Witness highlights of some of the action from Starrcade '88, including Lex Luger challenging Ric Flair for the World Heavyweight Championship, the finals of the tournament to crown new United States Tag Team Champions, and Mike Rotunda defending the World Television Championship against Rick Steiner. Plus, The Fantastics and more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 07, 1989
videos.overview: Jim Ross and Tony Schiavone look at some of the most exciting matches and rivalries from 1988. From the clash between Jim Cornette's Midnight Express and Paul E. Dangerously's Original Midnight Express to Sting challenging Ric Flair for the World Heavyweight Title at Clash of the Champions, all the year's memorable moments are revisited.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 14, 1989
videos.overview: After being assaulted by both World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair and United States Heavyweight Champion Barry Windham, "Hot Stuff" Eddie Gilbert promises to bring a friend back to the NWA to even the odds against The Four Horsemen. Plus, Mike Rotunda challenges Rick Steiner for the World Television Championship and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 21, 1989
videos.overview: Ric Flair is faced with a new threat to his reign as World Heavyweight Champion when Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat returns to the NWA to team up with "Hot Stuff" Eddie Gilbert against "The Nature Boy" and United States Heavyweight Champion Barry Windham. Plus, Michael P.S. Hayes in action, Butch Reed faces George South, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jan. 28, 1989
videos.overview: The recently-returned Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat has an altercation with his longtime rival and current World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair. Plus, Rick Steiner defends the World Television Championship, Lex Luger in action, and World Tag Team Champions The Road Warriors send a message to United States Tag Team Champions The Varsity Club.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 04, 1989
videos.overview: When Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat prepares for his upcoming World Heavyweight Championship Match against Ric Flair with a public workout, "The Nature Boy" gives the challenger for his title a preview of things to come. Plus, Sting partners with Junkyard Dog & Michael P.S. Hayes, Jim Cornette's Midnight Express in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 11, 1989
videos.overview: Paul Ellering and The Road Warriors take on The Varsity Club in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Ric Steiner puts the World Television Championship on the line against Pretty Boy Lloyd. Jim Cornette promises to rid the NWA of Paul E. Dangerously. Plus, World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair sends a message to Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 18, 1989
videos.overview: Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat and World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair exchange their final words before they meet for "The Nature Boy's title. In preparation for his United States Heavyweight Championship Match against Barry Windham, Lex Luger takes to the ring for singles competition. Plus, Sting, Abdullah The Butcher, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Feb. 25, 1989
videos.overview: Take an in-depth look at what transpired at Chi-Town Rumble '89 and see what led to Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat's victory over Ric Flair to become the new World Heavyweight Champion. Plus, witness several top Superstars of the National Wrestling Alliance in action, including Butch Reed, Dick Murdoch, Michael Hayes, and many more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 04, 1989
videos.overview: On a night where World Heavyweight Champion Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat sends a message to the fans of the NWA, Paul E. Dangerously's Danger Zone hosts a special interview with the former champion, Ric Flair. Plus, Mike Rotunda defends the World Television Championship, The Midnight Express in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 11, 1989
videos.overview: Ric Flair takes to the ring to show the world that he still has the heart of a champion. Before teaming with Michael P.S. Hayes in The Omni, United States Heavyweight Champion Lex Luger joins Paul E. Dangerously on The Danger Zone. Plus, Cougar Jay challenges Mike Rotunda for the World Television Championship, Sting in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 18, 1989
videos.overview: Michael Hayes & United States Heavyweight Champion Lex Luger take on Barry & Kendall Windham in a huge main event. More than just championship gold is on the line when Mike Rotunda defends the World Television Championship. Plus, Ranger Ross makes his in-ring debut, Gary Hart introduces a new client, Sting in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Mar. 25, 1989
videos.overview: As World Heavyweight Champion Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat takes to the ring for competition, Ric Flair promises to end his title reign. Randy Rose confronts Paul E. Dangerously on The Danger Zone. Plus, The Varsity Club's Mike Rotunda puts the World Television Championship on the line, The Samoan Swat Team in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 01, 1989
videos.overview: Sting challenges Mike Rotunda for the World Television Championship. United States Tag Team Champions Rick Steiner and "Hot Stuff" Eddie Gilbert take on Kevin Sullivan & Dan Spivey. Plus, Paul E. Dangerously welcomes Gary Hart to The Danger Zone, World Heavyweight Champion Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat sends a message to Ric Flair, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 08, 1989
videos.overview: Jim Ross shows highlights of the controversial battle between Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat and Ric Flair for the World Heavyweight Championship. World Television Champion Sting joins Paul E. Dangerously on The Danger Zone. Plus, Bob Orton and Shane Douglas meet in one-on-one action and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 15, 1989
videos.overview: The rivalry between Michael P.S. Hayes and United States Heavyweight Champion Lex Luger explodes when "The Total Package" takes to the ring for singles competition. Ron Simmons goes one-on-one with World Heavyweight Champion Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat in the main event. Jim Cornette makes an announcement about the future of his Midnight Express.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 22, 1989
videos.overview: The Samoan Swat Team takes on United States Tag Team Champions Rick Steiner and "Hot Stuff" Eddie Gilbert. World Heavyweight Champion Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat exchanges words with the challenger for his title Ric Flair. Michael P.S. Hayes continues his pursuit of singles gold. Plus, Tonga makes his debut, Bob Orton Jr. in action, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Apr. 29, 1989
videos.overview: Ric Flair promises to take the World Heavyweight Championship from Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat by starting a victory celebration a little early. United States Tag Team Champions The First Family face World Tag Team Champions The Varsity Club. Ron Simmons meets Junkyard Dog, an interview with United States Heavyweight Champion Lex Luger, and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 06, 1989
videos.overview: Ric Flair and Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat each take to the ring to compete in singles action. The rivalry between The Road Warriors and World Tag Team Champions The Varsity Club erupts. The Iron Sheik leads Rip Morgan to challenge Sting for the World Television Championship. Plus, Teddy Long protests his recent firing and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 13, 1989
videos.overview: Despite reclaiming the World Heavyweight Title at WrestleWar '89, Ric Flair recuperates from an injury caused by his newest enemy, Terry Funk. WCW Executive Vice President Jim Herd gives an update on the upcoming tournament for the World Tag Team Championship. Plus, United States Tag Team Champions The Fabulous Freebirds in action and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 20, 1989
videos.overview: The tournament to crown new World Tag Team Champions begins with The Road Warriors taking on The Fabulous Freebirds. Sting defends the World Television Championship against Jack Victory. Eddie Guerrero goes one-on-one with Terry Funk. Plus, Ron Simmons, Scott Steiner, Butch Reed, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - May. 27, 1989
videos.overview: On a night where The Samoan Swat Team looks to advance in the World Tag Team Title Tournament by taking on Ron Simmons & Ranger Ross, Jim Cornette makes a big announcement regarding his Midnight Express. Plus, an update on World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair's injuries, The Great Muta competes in an Oriental Torture Match, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 03, 1989
videos.overview: Dick Murdoch unwittingly changes the landscape of the World Tag Team Championship Tournament when Bob Orton & Butch Reed battle Jim Cornette's Midnight Express. The situation between Ron Simmons and Ranger Ross comes to a head. Sting takes exception to Terry Funk's brazen attempt to mock World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 10, 1989
videos.overview: Jim Ross conducts a controversial interview with the Terry Funk. The Steiner Brothers make a statement at the expense of The Varsity Club. Frustrations over recent managerial decisions get the best of United States Heavyweight Champion Lex Luger. Plus, The Great Muta, Ranger Ross, Dick Murdoch, and many more in action.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 17, 1989
videos.overview: The rivalry between The Midnight Express and new World Tag Team Champions The Fabulous Freebirds continues when Jim Cornette makes his presence felt in a main event bout between Terry Gordy and "Dr. Death" Steve Williams. Plus, an update on Ric Flair's condition, Lex Luger explains his attack on Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat, and much more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jun. 24, 1989
videos.overview: Jim Cornette's Midnight Express challenge The Fabulous Freebirds for the World Tag Team Championship. While the world waits for the upcoming announcement from Ric Flair on his in-ring future, Terry Funk sends a message to "The Nature Boy." All this and more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 01, 1989
videos.overview: In spite of his recent injuries, Ric Flair vows to continue his in-ring career and asks NWA Executive Vice President Jim Herd for a chance to defend the World Heavyweight Championship against Terry Funk at The Great American Bash '89. Tommy Rich faces Wild Bill Irwin. Plus, The Skyscrapers, Paul E. Dangerously's Samoan Swat Team, and many more.

videos.title: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 08, 1989
videos.overview: Terry Funk joins Paul E. Dangerously on The Danger Zone. Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat issues a challenge to Lex Luger for the United States Championship. Plus, The Steiner Brothers, Flyin' Brian Pillman, The Fabulous Freebirds, and many more in action.
